question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
director_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        movie_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (date_published - prev_date)) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE NULL
        END as inter_movie_duration_days
    FROM director_with_lag
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(inter_movie_duration_days), 0)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        CAST(SUM(total_votes) AS INTEGER) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        CAST(SUM(duration) AS INTEGER) as total_duration
    FROM inter_movie_diff
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    name_id as director_id,
    n.name as director_name,
    movie_count,
    avg_inter_movie_duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    min_rating,
    max_rating,
    total_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
